name: Goodyear
verdict: Nasdaq-listed (GT); its 2026 proxy's largest reported owners are index managers BlackRock (11.5%), Vanguard (10.2%), Wellington (8.8%) and Dimensional (5.8%). Nothing found.
note: Exclusive LMGT3 tyre supplier, extended to at least 2029 (fiawec.com news, 2026-06-11) and shown as tyre partner on LMGT3 car pages; Iron Lynx also lists Goodyear in its own partner block (ironlynx.com, checked 2026-10-03).
